## Verifier: **pass**

`spec.json` carries `"spec": null` — no `acceptance_checks` were recorded for this work item. I derived the checks from the task title (*Gardening: untested report page (src/report.js)*) and from the claims the commit message makes, and verified each against the running app rather than against the suite alone.

Ran from the manifest: `npm ci`, then `node src/server.js` with `.factory/sandbox/.runtime.env` sourced (`PORT=3000`). App logged `listening on 3000`; `/health` returned 200.

### Checks

| \# | Check | Result | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `/report` empty state renders `lines: 0`, `units: 0`, `value: $0.00` | pass | `check1-report-empty.png`, `.txt` |
| 2 | `/report` with the runbook seed renders `lines: 3`, `units: 16`, `value: $297.37` | pass | `check2-report-seeded.png`, `.txt` |
| 3 | `report.totals` agrees with `util.total` in the running app | pass | `/` shows `total: $297.37`, identical to `/report` |
| 4 | The suite runs and passes | pass | 7/7, exit 0 — `check3-npm-test.txt` |
| 5 | The suite actually covers `src/report.js` | pass | 100% line / branch / func; `coverage/lcov.info` records `SF:src/report.js`, LF 31 / LH 31 |
| 6 | `src/report.js` is unchanged, as the commit claims | pass | `git show` touches only `.gitignore`, `package.json`, `test/report.test.js` |
| 7 | `back` link works from `/report` | pass | clicked in Chromium, lands on `/` (title *Stock*) |

### Probing for tests that pass regardless

A new suite is only worth what it catches, so I mutated `src/report.js` three ways and re-ran, restoring the file each time (`git diff src/report.js` is empty, confirmed at the end):

- `units` counting lines instead of summing qty → **2 failures**
- `fmt` dropping the dollar sign → **2 failures**
- line value using `price` instead of `qty * price` → **3 failures**

Exit code propagates correctly: **1** with a broken `report.js`, **0** restored. The gate will not be blind to a regression here.

Also checked: `npm run lint` still exits 0 (the new file is outside `eslint src`); `npm test` is repeatable and recreates `coverage/` from scratch after `rm -rf coverage`; the run leaves the tree clean (`coverage/` is gitignored by this commit). The only browser console error is the 404 for `/favicon.ico`, which the runbook documents as expected.

### One follow-up, not a failure

The manifest still records `commands.test` as `null` and lists *"Automated tests and total coverage"* under `capabilities.not_exercised` — both frozen when the repo had no runner. This PR adds one, so the **tests gate is still pointed at `null` and will keep treating this repo as untested** until the manifest is amended. I ran the suite by hand, which is why this does not hold up the verdict. The runbook anticipated exactly this (*"whoever adds it should also set `commands.test` through an amendment so the gate stops being blind"*). Written up in `sandbox-report.json`; suggested value `npm test`, coverage from `coverage/lcov.info`, whose `SF:` paths are repo-relative.

App stopped and browser closed; no leftover processes.
